My name no dey important, but I be farmer for North Central here, and this small rice plot na my household own. I go put small chemical fertilizer because rice no go yield well without am, but fertilizer price high so I go manage wetin I fit buy. I no get irrigation for this plot, na the rain I dey follow, and I go use improved seed wey the agro-dealer dey sell because e dey give better harvest than the local one I plant before. My wife and children go help me, but for transplanting and harvesting time I must hire small labor because the work plenty pass us.
